notes.title: Fresh Looks Unlocked
notes.notes: [p]A fresh wave of stylish and powerful skins has arrived in the Hero’s Chamber! From ceremonial warriors to arcane mystics, this new collection brings flair, strength, and expression to your heroes.[/p][p]Visit the Prize Room to explore these unique looks and equip your favorites to stand out in battle![/p]

notes.title: Update notes for 7.6.4
notes.notes:
- Music and sound effects volume controls have been added to all pause screens.
- Various minor fixes and overall performance improvements.

notes.title: Cosmic Portals: Void Abyss
notes.notes: [p]A mysterious portals pulse with ancient energy. From its depths, whispers echo of a forgotten realm where reality bends and shadows think.[/p][p]Step into the Void Abyss Weekly Dungeon and test your resolve against otherworldly horrors. Survive the unknown, uncover hidden power, and claim cosmic rewards before the rift closes again.[/p]

notes.title: Fortress of Eternal Winter
notes.notes:
The cold is unforgiving in the Fortress of Eternal Winter, where frost coats every stone and danger lies frozen in silence.

Those who survive won’t walk away empty-handed: complete the Dungeon to claim the Tidecaller, a powerful relic said to carry the essence of the sea itself.

notes.title: Lich Skulls Unleashed
notes.notes:
A bold new wave of skins has arrived! Embrace the mystique of skull-themed designs inspired by the Lich and his arcane magic. Each skin brings its own unique flair — perfect for players looking to stand out with a touch of dark style.

Now available to claim in the Prize Room!

notes.title: Duels of Destiny
notes.notes:
The Duels of Destiny are here! Our ranked real-time PvP mode has arrived, where matchmaking pits you against worthy challengers!

Just look for the Portal of Destiny in the Tavern, where a mysterious figure will guide your way.

This phase of testing is crucial to refining matchmaking and ensuring the best possible experience, as we continue to improve our servers.

What's Next?

🏆 Greater rewards for high-ranked players
⚔️ PvP-exclusive class abilities to shake up combat
🎮 More exciting updates to come!

Step into the arena, where destiny calls, challengers rise, and legends are forged!

Your Magic Rampage Team

notes.title: Hop to Victory!
notes.notes:
High above the clouds, hidden by time, the ancient Floating Islands reemerge. Among forgotten ruins and colossal statues, the remnants of a lost civilization tell stories no one remembers. But something still slumbers among the clouds…

This Easter, battle exotic creatures, explore abandoned temples, and uncover the ancient mysteries waiting for you above the clouds. What really happened here? Only the bravest will find out.

notes.title: Update Notes For April 11
notes.notes: -Staves ignore 4% of the target’s armor, while grimoires bypass 8% as usual. These values are subject to change in the future if balancing adjustments are needed.

notes.title: New & Classic Skins!
notes.notes:
A brand-new set of skins has arrived with the new season! Customize your look and show off your style in battle.  

But that's not all! We're bringing back some old-school classics! The Prize Room will feature a rotating collection of legendary skins from past seasons. If you missed out on them before, now's your chance to add them to your collection!

notes.title: The Witch Of The Crimson Forest 2
notes.notes:
The Scarlet Witch is back, and this time, she’s out for revenge! Dark magic surges through the Crimson Forest once more, corrupting everything in its path. Prepare for a fierce battle as she unleashes her newfound power against all who dare to challenge her.

Venture into this new Weekly Dungeon, face the darkness head-on, and prove your strength against the Witch of the Crimson Forest!

notes.title: New PvP mode available!
notes.notes:
Duels, our new real-time PvP mode, are now available in open beta! Challenge friends and other players in the Tavern!

Ranked matches with random matchmaking are coming soon! Get ready to duel and share your thoughts!

This beta phase aims to gather valuable feedback to help us improve the new mode further. We are still working on enhancing our servers, so some players might experience high ping rates. More servers worldwide are on the way!

Patch-notes:

- Hammers, maces, and some heavy axes now knock enemies back on impact.
- New Power-Up: Instant Gust is now available in the Tavern! This powerful ability pushes enemies back with a strong gust every time you attack.
- Exciting Update: Most of the third-party licensed music from the campaign has been replaced with brand-new original tracks! This means content creators can now monetize Magic Rampage videos without worrying about music licensing issues.

notes.title: The Temple of Anubis 2
notes.notes:
Prepare for a new challenge in the Weekly Dungeons! The Temple of Anubis 2 awaits, filled with deadly mummies, ancient traps, and hidden treasures. Navigate through perilous ruins and uncover secrets from the past.

Only the bravest will conquer this dungeon and claim the exclusive rewards! Are you ready to face the wrath of Anubis? Jump in now and prove your skills against the ancient undead!

notes.title: New Power-Ups Unleashed!
notes.notes:
Get ready to elevate your Magic Rampage experience with our latest patch! Discover four powerful new power-ups: Starlight Supertonic, Instant Thunder Wave, Instant Charge Blast, and Instant Dark Twin.

These enhancements are designed to prepare you for the upcoming Duels Mode, adding thrilling new strategies and excitement to your adventures. Dive into the action and harness the power of these incredible new abilities!

notes.title: The Witch Of The Crimson Forest
notes.notes:
Adventurers, prepare yourselves for an eerie challenge in this week's dungeon event: The Witch Of The Crimson Forest. Venture deep into the haunted forest, where the formidable Scarlet Witch reigns supreme. Unravel the mysteries of her dark magic, and test your skills against her powerful spells and minions.

Do you have what it takes to conquer the Scarlet Witch and emerge victorious? Join the adventure now and prove your might in the Crimson Forest. Good luck, heroes!

notes.title: Update Notes for June 30th
notes.notes:
-When affected by frost, repeatedly pressing jump button now reduces freeze time.
-Grimoire's magic strike now has the ability to partially bypass some of the target's armor.
-Spears of any element and all other light elemental weapons will no longer suffer a significant damage reduction when piercing through targets or shields.
-Tonic of Invulnerability and Pepper Brew power-ups now also increase user's armor.
-Power-ups no longer allowed during the initial play-through of a Campaign Dungeon in Rampage Mode, to enhance the challenge and encourage skill-based progression.
-Minor bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 27
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: The Deadly Carnival 2024
notes.notes: Gear up and put on your masks for an enchanting escapade in our exclusive Carnival dungeon! Encounter everything from nimble clowns to eerie jesters in this time-limited event, brimming with intricate challenges, bountiful treasures, and rewards. Embark on a thrilling quest that promises an unforgettable adventure!

notes.title: Christmas Rampage
notes.notes: Navigate through a maze of enchanted toys and solve puzzles to save Santa Claus himself! Prepare for a unique blend of eerie Christmas atmosphere and intense adventure. Are you brave enough to confront these menacing challenges?

notes.title: Weekly Dungeon: Temple of Anubis
notes.notes:
Adventurers, the Temple of Anubis awaits! Step back in time to the golden era of ancient Egypt. This mystical journey will challenge you with mummies, riddles, and secrets only the brave dare to uncover.

Delve deep into the sands of eternity and unveil treasures beyond imagination. Do you have the courage to face the ancient guardians and unravel the Temple's mysteries?

[list]
[*] New eye colors now available for customization
[*] Minor security enhancements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: The Secret Caverns
notes.notes:
Attention all adventurers!

Discover the mysteries of an icy cave, filled with challenges and hidden treasures. Your journey will lead you to the skeleton of a long-dead dragon, frozen in time.

But beware, as danger lurks around every corner. Are you brave enough to uncover the secrets of The Secret Caverns? Grab your weapons and gear and join us for this unforgettable adventure!

notes.title: The Cursed Maze
notes.notes: Weekly Dungeon! The whole timeline mess has created this dangerously frightening maze. Muster up the courage to find your way out!

notes.title: Skins and New Game+!
notes.notes:
We're super exited to bring you new epic class-skins to customize your characters! You can exchange your rank points for unique skins at the end of each Season!

Get a sneak peak at all skins for the current season in the Prize Room.

And there's more! You can now start a new game on Rampage Mode! Rampage Mode brings the true hard mode that will put the best player's skills to the test! With legendary items as a reward!

[h3]What's new on Steam:[/h3]

Thanks to feedback from the massive amount of new players who joined Steam, we made a number of under-the-hood adjustments to make the single player campaign more challenging and rewarding on PC.

Listening to community feedback, we've also added the possibility to customize keyboard controls on PC.

notes.title: Magic Rampage 5.6.0 Beta now available
notes.notes:
The next major update is now available to all beta testers. Featuring the new Rampage Mode (aka New Game+), Competitive Seasons, Skins and keyboard controls customization on PC.

Patch notes:
-Introducing new epic class-skins to customize your characters! You can exchange your rank points for unique skins at the end of each Season!
-You can now start a new game on Rampage Mode! Rampage Mode brings the true hard mode that will put the best players' skills to the test! With legendary items as a reward!
-Dark Twin HP nerfed.

Steam:
-Added keyboard control customization.
-Added balances in campaign difficulty level.

notes.title: The Cursed Ice
notes.notes:
Don't miss this week's Dungeon for epic rewards and awesome challenges!

Featuring the Ice Axe! An awesome weapon with huge area damage to freeze all enemies around, making it ideal for crowded areas.  

Also the Ice Dagger has been added to the shop!

Will you be ready to conquer the long-forgotten horrors and treasures this deep and dark cavern holds?

notes.title: Magic Rampage will soon be free-to-play on Steam!
notes.notes:
In 2020, we opened the early access to Magic Rampage on Steam. Our main goal was to bring the premium Magic Rampage experience to players who were already playing the mobile version of the game.

As time passed, we noticed that the paid version was simply not accessible to enough of our fan-base. To make it accessible to as many players as possible, Magic Rampage will be completely free to play on Steam!

This change doesn't impact players who have already bought the premium edition; prices and prizes will be balanced the old way, and the player's account will permanently keep the premium status.

notes.title: Introducing Episode 5-4!
notes.notes:
The wheels of time keep on spinning as our heroes are about to recover the missing Lunar Map. Is it going to be enough to fix the whole timeline mess?

Things might not be as simple as they look, for our team could need a little help from the lady Captain to get things done!

notes.title: The Halloween 2021 event is here!
notes.notes:
Magic Rampage will celebrate it with a new themed Weekly dungeon full of seasonal loot! Including the acclaimed [b]Witch Dress[/b] and the [b]Witch Broom[/b]!

One more thing! You're going to love the all new and unique [b]Vest of Phantoms Keeper[/b] as a main prize for this season's dungeon!

Don't miss it!

notes.title: The Skill Tree is here!
notes.notes:
We're excited to introduce you to the Skill Tree! Learn epic new tricks and build your own combat strategies!

The Tree of Skills is found inside the Training Hall and can be accessed at any time from the player menu.

Skills are separated into three specialization tracks: Force, Wisdom and Courage. Choose which awesome new abilities suit your own play style and get to the fight now!

notes.title: The Fabled Chambers
notes.notes:
Prepare to face the fiercest bosses in the deadly chambers for some epic loot!

[h3]WEEKLY DUNGEONS - Live ops![/h3]

A new Dungeon every week! Each week, players will be presented with unique challenges and epic rewards from the Golden Chest!

Weekly Dungeons offer time and star challenges in three levels of difficulty. Additionally, you get extra Rank points every day you complete it.

notes.title: Episode 5-3 Released!
notes.notes:
In a lust for infinite power, the Corrupted King wasn't trying to save his castle after all. On the other side, the resistance carries the plan to infiltrate the castle through the sewers, looking for the missing Lunar Map that would undo all the timeline mess!

Has the time for the final encounter finally arrived? Is the Corrupted King up to something? Find out the answers for these, and many other questions in episode 5-3 of Magic Rampage!

notes.title: Early Access is here!
notes.notes:
Seven years ago, Magic Rampage brought the full experience of an epic Action-RPG to the mobile world, and now the time has come to join the adventure on the big screen!

Players will have the chance to play the game in its definitive, premium edition and be part of the development by providing valuable feedback which will help us improve and finalize the game.

The premium edition is ad free and includes the 2P Local Versus mode. The game economy was completely rebalanced to provide the definitive experience free of microtransactions.
